scope: why the client disconnects after the port fix

evidence_chain.validation_function: 0x4730A0 returns 0, so the caller takes the error branch

meaning: the disconnect is not a snapshot problem at all: the client's gamestate configstring self-check fails. CL_ParseGamestate reads the ui_mapname and ui_gametype dvars, finds them inconsistent (both empty in our run), and raises EXE_CONFIGSTRINGMISMATCH, which drops the client.
why: the 2697 gamestate carries the map/gametype as configstrings, but the client's ui_mapname/ui_gametype dvars are still empty when the check runs -- either the configstrings are not applied before the check, or the 1649370 client requires a different configstring set than the 2697 server sends.
next: make the server set ui_mapname/ui_gametype (or the configstrings they derive from) before the check, or patch 0x4730A0 to return 1
patching the check is a one-line way to get past it and see whether the next blocker is the snapshot
either way the client now disconnects for a reason that is fully identified
